raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stack (3/6), merge in order: [#44851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44851) → [#44852](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44852) → [#44853](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44853) → [#44854](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44854) → [#44863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44863) → [#44869](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44869)

## Motivation

With top-k 1 and every draft step retained, frozen-KV MTP has a single chain. Probability ranking cannot change which nodes reach target verification, but the current path still computes full-vocabulary softmax, cumulative scores, frontier gathers, and tree ranking.

## Modifications

Select draft logits directly and construct the chain metadata without ranking. Keep the generic path for branching or pruned trees. Return contiguous metadata for the CUDA tree builder's layout contract.

Depends on #44852. Target weights and verification are unchanged; finite-precision softmax ties can resolve differently in assistant proposals.

## Accuracy Tests

Two CPU-tensor unit tests cover six configurations, including the one-step empty-parent boundary and generic-path fallbacks. A deliberate parent-index mutation makes the topology test fail. XPU serving tests and six greedy parity prompts pass.

GSM8K smoke: 82%/200, zero errors, two truncations. No quality-equivalence claim.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same physical Intel Arc Pro B70, TP1 BF16, context 8,192, KV capacity 32,768, max running requests 8; captured MTP with three steps/four verification tokens. Fixed 256-token OpenAI chat requests, two repeats per variant/concurrency. Controls bracket the initial candidate runs; the final contiguous-layout candidate was also measured separately.

| Concurrency | Generic TPOT | Chain TPOT | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 4.295 ms | 4.171 ms | 2.9% |
| 8 | 5.974 ms | 5.779 ms | 3.3% |

Output throughput increases from 220.6 to 228.8 tok/s and from 1,174.4 to 1,220.0 tok/s, respectively. These are workload-specific measurements.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit checks.
- [x] Derived topology/layout tests and XPU serving regressions.
- [x] Greedy parity, accuracy smoke, and same-device serving benchmarks.
- [x] No new configuration or documentation required.

+"""Full-chain MTP preserves generic tree topology without probability ranking."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.speculative import frozen_kv_mtp_worker_v2 as module
+from sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_utils import organize_draft_results
+from sglang.srt.speculative.frozen_kv_mtp_info import FrozenKVMTPDraftInput
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import select_top_k_tokens
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestFrozenKVMTPChain(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.compiler.set_stance("force_eager")
+    def check_tree(self, steps, topk, width):
+        bs = 3
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(17)
+        logits = [
+            torch.randn((bs * topk, 37), generator=generator) * 3 for _ in range(steps)
+        ]
+        hidden = [
+            torch.randn((bs * topk, 8), generator=generator) for _ in range(steps)
+        ]
+        calls = []
+
+        def forward(batch):
+            i = len(calls)
+            calls.append(
+                (batch.input_ids.clone(), batch.spec_info.hidden_states.clone())
+            )
+            return SimpleNamespace(
+                logits_output=SimpleNamespace(
+                    next_token_logits=logits[i], hidden_states=hidden[i]
+                )
+            )
+
+        seed = FrozenKVMTPDraftInput(
+            bonus_tokens=torch.arange(bs), hidden_states=torch.ones(bs, 8)
+        )
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            spec_info=seed, needs_forward_metadata_init=lambda: False
+        )
+        worker = SimpleNamespace(
+            topk=topk,
+            speculative_num_steps=steps,
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=width,
+            draft_model_runner=SimpleNamespace(forward=forward),
+            draft_attn_backend=None,
+            _set_positions=lambda b: None,
+            _target_kv_pool_view=lambda b: nullcontext(),
+        )
+        with patch.object(module, "forward_context", lambda context: nullcontext()):
+            actual = module.FrozenKVMTPDraftWorker.draft_forward(worker, batch)
+        scores = None
+        score_list = []
+        token_list = []
+        parent_list = []
+        expected_calls = []
+        for i in range(steps):
+            current_logits = logits[i][::topk] if i == 0 else logits[i]
+            current_hidden = hidden[i][::topk] if i == 0 else hidden[i]
+            probabilities = torch.softmax(current_logits, dim=-1)
+            topk_probs, indices = torch.topk(probabilities, topk, dim=-1)
+            inputs, selected_hidden, scores, tree = select_top_k_tokens(
+                i, topk_probs, indices, current_hidden, scores, topk
+            )
+            score_list.append(tree[0])
+            token_list.append(tree[1])
+            parent_list.append(tree[2])
+            if i < steps - 1:
+                expected_calls.append((inputs, selected_hidden))
+        expected = organize_draft_results(score_list, token_list, parent_list, width)
+        for a, b in zip(actual, expected):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            # The CUDA tree builder checks the packed-row layout, whereas
+            # the XPU implementation accepts expanded views as well.
+            self.assertTrue(a.is_contiguous())
+        for a, b in zip(calls[1:], expected_calls):
+            for x, y in zip(a, b):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(x, y, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_full_chain_preserves_tree_and_recurrent_inputs(self):
+        # Parent layout has a special one-step boundary; later steps must
+        # preserve each request's hidden state without a frontier gather.
+        for steps in (1, 2, 3, 5):
+            with self.subTest(steps=steps):
+                self.check_tree(steps, 1, steps + 1)
+
+    def test_pruned_and_branching_trees_keep_probability_ranking(self):
+        for topk, width in ((1, 3), (2, 5)):
+            with self.subTest(topk=topk, width=width):
+                self.check_tree(3, topk, width)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
